name: Rundll32.exe
description: Used by Windows to execute dll files
author: Oddvar Moe

commands.description: First part should be a DLL file (any extension accepted), EntryPoint should be the name of the entry point in the DLL file to execute.
commands.os: Windows vista, Windows 7, Windows 8, Windows 8.1, Windows 10, Windows 11

commands.description: Execute a DLL from an SMB share. EntryPoint is the name of the entry point in the DLL file to execute.
commands.os: Windows vista, Windows 7, Windows 8, Windows 8.1, Windows 10, Windows 11

commands.description: Use Rundll32.exe to execute a JavaScript script that calls a remote JavaScript script.
commands.os: Windows vista, Windows 7, Windows 8, Windows 8.1, Windows 10, Windows 11

commands.description: Use Rundll32.exe to execute a .DLL file stored in an Alternate Data Stream (ADS).
commands.usecase: Execute code from alternate data stream
commands.os: Windows vista, Windows 7, Windows 8, Windows 8.1, Windows 10, Windows 11

commands.description: Use Rundll32.exe to load a registered or hijacked COM Server payload. Also works with ProgID.
commands.usecase: Execute a DLL/EXE COM server payload or ScriptletURL code.

detection: Outbount Internet/network connections made from rundll32
Suspicious use of cmdline flags such as -sta
